propositions: Gerrit CI loads workflow definition from target branch but checks out the change's tree, causing divergence when a new gate script lands.
Gate steps that unconditionally invoke newly-landed scripts fail on pre-gate changes with 'No such file or directory' error.
New gate scripts must be guarded with an existence check to skip gracefully (with log) when the script is absent from the checked-out tree.
Both raw-git-write and wall-clock-assert gate steps require if-present guards; the guard idiom and skew rationale must be documented inline in the workflow for future gate authors.
